summary: U Power Ltd, a Shanghai-based foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K furnishing its interim financial information for the period ended June 30, 2026, disclosed November 6, 2026. The exhibit set covers balance-sheet and related-party items, loans, leases and share-consolidation disclosures across Class A and Class B capital, including a post-consolidation event dated September 9, 2026. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor or closing date is stated. This is a routine periodic-report filing, not a special situation; watch only for any separately announced capital action.
